objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level (1-4) in the document pyramid indicating strategic vs. operational scope.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code prefix for the document name, e.g. RL for guideline.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client 4-digit number per document type included in the document name.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The descriptive title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the document, incremented on revisions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiry date based on Valid From plus the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The time period (default 3 years) for which the document remains valid after release.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period (default 10 years) for which invalidated documents are archived before physical deletion.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to master data or other documents maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Associated IT application references maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity assigned to the document.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Scope or areas to which the document applies.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g. Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The original language in which the document content is maintained.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: The client(s) in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document attached to a main document that is automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the attachment, subject to own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment following the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document, released directly via property switches.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to suggest changes to an existing released document without affecting its content or version history directly.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document and archive it, created when a document has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated (archived) document, created in a designated folder.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in various roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, reader, or translator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users used to assign authorizations, distribution, and role-based access to documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons maintained per document who are informed about releases via email or acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process that manages the approval steps (creator, review, release) including electronic signatures.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by workflow participants to confirm completion of their workflow task.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: System functionality ensuring complete traceability of document changes and approval processes.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity (department, location) to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process to which documents can be linked for process-specific filing.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk entity to which documents can be linked in the system.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific view providing users with relevant document information, lists, and evaluation reports.

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation report providing filtered information about documents based on selection parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report such as status report, search, or acknowledgement report.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is attached in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the local Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated via the properties editing dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval workflow (creator, review, release) is initiated by the author or co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and formal correctness during the review workflow step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it available to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the process for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when changes to content, attributes, or attachments occur.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, notifying the creator.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of a document is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: A document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request is created to reactivate a previously invalidated document by the Business Admin group.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is re-validated, creating a new version with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: Documents are physically deleted after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are assigned to a document's distribution list for email or acknowledgement notification.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language by a translator.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version is checked and released via a workflow, making it visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends email notifications to users about workflow tasks, releases, or status changes.

o2o.description: An attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main document.
Additional information is supplementary to a document without affecting its release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document whose validity is to be checked.

Users are assigned to user groups for authorization and role management.
Documents can be linked to processes for process-specific filing.
Documents can be linked to organizational units.
Documents can be linked to risks in the system.
Documents can reference other documents via the references attribute or local extensions in multi-client systems.
